  • Method Details

    • createTable

      public void createTable()
      Creates the user_preferences table if it does not already exist.

    • createDefaultRowsForMissingUsers

      public void createDefaultRowsForMissingUsers()
      Inserts a default preferences row for every user who does not yet have one. Uses a single INSERT … SELECT … WHERE NOT EXISTS query for efficiency.

    • getByUserId

      public GamePreferences getByUserId(int userId)
      Returns the saved GamePreferences for the given user id. Falls back to GamePreferences.defaults() if no row is found.
      Parameters:
      userId - the primary key of the user whose preferences to load
      Returns:
      the user's GamePreferences, or default preferences if not found

    • saveForUserId

      public void saveForUserId(int userId, GamePreferences preferences)
      Inserts or updates the preferences row for the given user id using an UPSERT (INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) operation.
      Parameters:
      userId - the primary key of the user whose preferences should be saved
      preferences - the GamePreferences to persist; ignored if null
